evidence.claim: Tshisekedi chaired an evaluation meeting on the 145 territories development program with the prime minister, sector ministers, and partner agencies, and the presidency said the identified projects were ready and the program comprised nearly 200 works such as hospitals and administrative buildings.
evidence.title: Réunion d'évaluation du programme de développement à la base des 145 territoires
evidence.excerpt: Tshisekedi chaired an evaluation meeting on the 145 territories development program with the prime minister, sector ministers, and partner agencies, and the presidency said the identified projects were ready and the program comprised nearly 200 works such as hospitals and administrative buildings.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official account gives a concrete implementation milestone, though it is still government self-report.
evidence.period_fit: Mid-2022 implementation inside the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution: the meeting was chaired by Tshisekedi and tied to his named program.
contrary_evidence: Readiness claims are official and not independently audited here.

evidence.claim: Tshisekedi said the M23 advance had created a humanitarian crisis with more than 200,000 displaced people and that the government had been instructed to gather and care for them.
evidence.title: Adresse a la nation du President de la Republique, Felix Tshisekedi suite a la deterioration de la situation securitaire a l'est du pays
evidence.excerpt: Tshisekedi said the M23 advance had created a humanitarian crisis with more than 200,000 displaced people and that the government had been instructed to gather and care for them.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential address states the crisis scale and the government's response order.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution: the instruction is explicitly issued by the president during a live crisis.
contrary_evidence: The underlying displacement is a negative external shock, not proof of competence by itself.

evidence.claim: The IMF said the DRC's macroeconomic environment had improved, the authorities had adopted prudent macroeconomic policies by halting central bank financing to the government, and further monetary, exchange-rate, natural-resource, and business-climate reforms were needed.
evidence.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Staff Report for the 2022 Article IV Consultation, Second Review Under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement
evidence.excerpt: The IMF said the DRC's macroeconomic environment had improved, the authorities had adopted prudent macroeconomic policies by halting central bank financing to the government, and further monetary, exchange-rate, natural-resource, and business-climate reforms were needed.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: IMF staff report is a strong independent macroeconomic source with explicit policy assessment.
evidence.period_fit: Mid-2022 assessment of the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate-to-high attribution: these policies are attributed to the authorities under Tshisekedi, but some constraints are inherited and technocratic.
contrary_evidence: IMF also says more reform is needed, so the record is mixed rather than definitive.

evidence.claim: The World Bank said growth rebounded strongly to 6.2 percent in 2021, but poverty reduction remained elusive; it also said the new telecom law and secondary legislation, fiber backbone investment, PPPs, and tax simplification were priority steps for digital-led growth and job creation.
evidence.title: Democratic Republic of Congo Economic Update: Harnessing Growth Through Digital Connectivity to Create Jobs and Reduce Poverty
evidence.excerpt: The World Bank said growth rebounded strongly to 6.2 percent in 2021, but poverty reduction remained elusive; it also said the new telecom law and secondary legislation, fiber backbone investment, PPPs, and tax simplification were priority steps for digital-led growth and job creation.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: World Bank press release combines outcome assessment with concrete policy recommendations.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate-to-high attribution: macro growth is partly commodity-driven and not fully ruler-owned, but the reform agenda is government-directed.
contrary_evidence: The report says poverty reduction was still elusive and much growth came from mining and external conditions.

evidence.claim: The IGF audit of state mining company Gecamines was commissioned by President Tshisekedi and found severe irregularities, including embezzlement and the disappearance of $414 million that should have reached the central bank.
evidence.title: DR Congo: State Mining Company Subject to a Damning Audit
evidence.excerpt: The IGF audit of state mining company Gecamines was commissioned by President Tshisekedi and found severe irregularities, including embezzlement and the disappearance of $414 million that should have reached the central bank.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent investigative report citing the IGF audit and the president's commissioning of it.
evidence.period_fit: Audit was commissioned before and finalized during 2022.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution for the commissioning decision; the underlying irregularities are company-level but within a state asset under presidential oversight.
contrary_evidence: The audit concerns a state company with legacy problems and does not prove personal wrongdoing by Tshisekedi.

evidence.claim: The EITI Board said DRC implementation generated tangible reforms with impetus from the Presidency, but also found beneficial-ownership rules only partly implemented and expressed concern about prosecutions of whistle-blowers.
evidence.title: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has achieved a high overall score in implementing the 2019 EITI Standard
evidence.excerpt: The EITI Board said DRC implementation generated tangible reforms with impetus from the Presidency, but also found beneficial-ownership rules only partly implemented and expressed concern about prosecutions of whistle-blowers.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: EITI validation is an authoritative external assessment combining performance and remaining gaps.
evidence.period_fit: 2022 validation outcome within the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution for presidency-driven follow-through; partial implementation limits the strength of the positive inference.
contrary_evidence: Beneficial ownership remained incomplete and whistleblower prosecutions cut against clean implementation.

evidence.claim: Human Rights Watch said Congolese authorities took no disciplinary action and did not investigate police involvement in the Buhene attacks, and that Tshisekedi later appointed the police commander in charge at the time as deputy territory administrator.
evidence.title: DR Congo: No Inquiry into Police Role in Ethnic Killings
evidence.excerpt: Human Rights Watch said Congolese authorities took no disciplinary action and did not investigate police involvement in the Buhene attacks, and that Tshisekedi later appointed the police commander in charge at the time as deputy territory administrator.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent rights report provides a specific accountability failure and a ruler-linked appointment.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution for the appointment decision; the lack of inquiry reflects authority exercised under Tshisekedi.
contrary_evidence: The article concerns a localized security episode, not the whole governing program.

evidence.claim: DW reported that several close associates of Tshisekedi were accused of corruption, that Tshisekedi had not yet reacted, and that Vidiye Tshimanga resigned after a video showed him negotiating a commission on a mining contract with fake investors.
evidence.title: Des proches de Tshisekedi accusés de corruption
evidence.excerpt: DW reported that several close associates of Tshisekedi were accused of corruption, that Tshisekedi had not yet reacted, and that Vidiye Tshimanga resigned after a video showed him negotiating a commission on a mining contract with fake investors.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent reporting captures the network-level scandal and the president's lack of immediate response.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Moderate attribution: the conduct is network-level, and the article specifically notes the president had not reacted at publication time.
contrary_evidence: The story centers on associates, so it is weaker for direct personal attribution than for network-control inference.

unresolved_gaps: No direct 2022 nuclear/existential-risk decision by Tshisekedi is evidenced, and the package never shows operational nuclear control, brinkmanship, or safeguard intervention.
Direct 2022 execution and household/distribution outcome evidence remains thinner than the policy and macro coverage.
Direct, nationally representative 2022 welfare-outcome evidence attributable to Tshisekedi remains limited relative to the amount of partner-led program evidence.

Direct personal-nexus evidence is still sparse: no clear 2022 asset-declaration, campaign-finance, beneficial-ownership, or court/audit record ties Tshisekedi himself to self-dealing or deliberate deception.
Independent, audited delivery and outcome evidence is thinner than the program rhetoric and internal reporting.
